input.query: SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-10' THEN 'pre_5.27' ELSE 'post_5.27' END period, SUM(n_decisions) decisions, SUM(n_approved) approved, SUM(n_approved)*1.0/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' AND decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1
